text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the spring Tenno Sho is here.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, McQueen! Get that third
title!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You can do it! Smash that record!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has already won the
spring
Tenno Sho twice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why beating her today would be a
miracle
that nobody expects. So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Go out there and make a miracle ha...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far ahead of me she gets,
I won't
give up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Were you not the one to invite us here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
B-but you guys are all too fast! Wait
uuup!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Good luck out there, Rice! We'll be
cheering you
on from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I'm looking forward to seeing you
become a
blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My objective here is to observe your
victory, not
your defeat.
